title: Safe zero-risk templates and marine water access resolution
body:
ZERO-RISK TEMPLATE HARDENING
- Pruned complex, fragile Polish regex patterns (subregions, historical unions, relative directions, coordinate and numeric comparisons) from deterministic template matching, ensuring all inflection-heavy Polish questions route cleanly to Gemini 2.5 Flash Lite.
- Retained only verified, zero-risk Polish starter questions (pure island, driving side, government type, pure sea access, broad continents, exact country identity and borders).
- Added strict directional coast guard preventing directional coast questions (e.g. 'west coastline?') from erroneously matching generic sea access.
- Added logical conjunction and slash filtering to reject compound multi-part questions from template matching.

WATER ACCESS & DISJUNCTIVE EXPLANATION FIX
- Fixed resolution of generic 'Sea' water access: correctly maps marine coastlines (seas, gulfs, bays) to sea access.
- Improved disjunctive ('or') explanation formatting: when a compound condition is satisfied, explains the satisfied branch cleanly without false negatives.
